div.div:
vs plain TLS
TLS: server proves identity only
client auth → app-layer token
mTLS: client identity in the handshake
before any app data flows
nothing bearer-shaped to steal/replay

div.div:
Scaling it: workload identity
SPIFFE — naming: spiffe://env/service in cert SAN
SPIRE — attests workload, issues short-lived SVIDs
Service mesh — automates issue/rotate/verify per hop
short cert lifetimes = rotation is the revocation
